summary: Jayud Global Logistics furnished a Form 6-K with unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, the US-equivalent of a routine half-year results announcement for a foreign private issuer. Revenue rose about RMB140.4 million, or 50.0%, to roughly RMB421.0 million (US$61.8 million), while cost of revenue climbed 62.8% to RMB425.0 million, producing a gross loss. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanic is disclosed; watch margin compression and freight-cost volatility rather than any arbitrage angle.
